text_blocks.snippet: Alterations in health diagnosis refer to changes or deviations from a normal or expected state of health. These alterations can manifest in various ways, including changes in physical symptoms, mental status, or functional abilities. They can be indicators of underlying medical conditions or diseases, or they can be a result of external factors. Nurses play a crucial role in identifying and addressing these alterations.
